tasks.prompt: Finish the existing SingleFlightCache in one focused module without dependencies. Keep the constructor new SingleFlightCache({ now } = {}) plus get(key, loader, { ttlMs = 0, signal } = {}) and invalidate(key). Concurrent gets for one key must share exactly one loader while different keys stay independent. Cache successful values, including undefined, until now() reaches the TTL boundary; ttlMs=0 coalesces only the pending load. A synchronous throw or rejected loader must evict so the next get retries. Caller abort must reject only that caller with an AbortError and must not cancel or evict the shared load for other callers. invalidate(key) must evict cached data and fence a pending generation so its later completion can resolve existing waiters but can never repopulate the cache or overwrite a newer generation. Validate loader, ttlMs, signal, and now() results, avoid unhandled rejections or listener leaks, preserve the public API, add useful tests, and run them.

requirements.text: Coalesce concurrent gets for the same key into one loader while keeping different keys independent.
Cache every successful value through the exclusive TTL boundary; ttlMs=0 caches only while pending.
Evict synchronous throws and asynchronous rejections so the next call retries cleanly.
Abort only the requesting caller with AbortError without cancelling or evicting the shared load.
Invalidate cached values and fence pending generations so stale completions cannot repopulate or overwrite newer data.

tasks.prompt: Harden this rotating-key webhook service without dependencies or a broad rewrite. WEBHOOK_SECRETS is a JSON object mapping key IDs to non-empty secrets; parse and validate it, provide a built-in clearly non-secret local key ring only when NODE_ENV is exactly development, and fail closed in every other mode. Keep verifyWebhook(rawBody, signatureHeader, secrets, nowSeconds) boolean and support string or Buffer bodies. Accept only the exact header grammar t=<unix-seconds>,kid=<1-32 ASCII letters/digits/_/->,v1=<64 hex>; sign the byte sequence ASCII(timestamp + '.') followed by the untouched raw body with HMAC-SHA256 using the own key selected by kid; reject unknown/inherited keys, malformed or duplicate fields, tampering, and timestamps more than 300 seconds old or future (the boundary is valid). Valid-length digests must use crypto.timingSafeEqual and malformed input returns false rather than throwing. Logs and orchestration must never expose the key ring, any secret, supplied header, or digest; pass only safe mode/accepted context into logging. Keep configuration, verification, logging, and app boundaries separate, add tests, and run them.

requirements.text: Parse and validate a WEBHOOK_SECRETS key ring, provide a built-in non-secret local ring only in exact development mode, and otherwise fail closed.
Select an own rotating key by kid and verify timestamp-prefixed string and Buffer raw bytes.
Require the exact t/kid/v1 header grammar and accept timestamps at most 300 seconds old or future, inclusive.
Reject malformed, unknown-key, inherited-key, and tampered inputs without throwing; compare valid digests with timingSafeEqual.
Logging and app orchestration receive only safe mode/accepted context and never expose key or signature material.
